name: com.bun3.unity.core
description: Bun3 shared toolkit for Unity. Includes ReadOnlyAttribute, UnifiedToggleGroup (N-preset toggle with extensible options and cascading groups), CancellationScope (structured cancellation-lifetime scope with UniTask helpers), and PlayerLoopSystemHelper (static per-frame callbacks via player-loop insertion).

samples.description: N preset states, custom-extensible options, and cascading control of nested groups.
